**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on Sparkling. I checked:

- **§ 11 Fees (p0084)** — Sparkling's sole pricing obligation is to pay the Fee Schedule fees; no parity, best-terms or match undertaking.
- **§ 10 Maintenance and Support / Page 5 (p0065, p0077–p0082)** — maintenance and repair charges are capped to Fee Schedule rates for defined excluded causes; no obligation on us to extend third-party terms to Garman.
- **§ 20 General Matters and Page 10 (p0134–p0147)** — boilerplate only (notices, waiver, assignment, independent contractor, force majeure, severability, governing law).
- **§ 1 Definitions and Schedules (p0007–p0026)** — no defined pricing-parity concept; Schedule "A" is a fixed Fee Schedule.
- Targeted searches for "no less favourable", "favourable/favorable", most-favoured-nation, best/lowest price, discount, competitor and third-party-offer matching returned nothing responsive.

No redline proposed — there is no Customer-side MFN to delete, and no Vendor-granted MFN to preserve. The absence of an MFN in our favour is noted only as a commercial observation, not a deviation under this rule.
